BAM/CRAM Insert-Size Counts

Source: R/insert_size.R
rduckhts_bam_insert_size_counts.Rd

Reduces eligible records into sparse orientation and absolute-TLEN counts using Fulcrum Genomics riker 0.4.1 semantics (MIT). Only non-first segments count; QC-fail records are excluded. The unsuffixed wrapper uses the native reducer; the `_sql` wrapper uses the SQL macro. The SQL arm projects binary CIGAR and flag/coordinate columns only; CRAM decoding also requests sequence and tags internally for long-CIGAR restoration. The native arm avoids these fields. For weighted metrics, materialize the counts and call `duckhts_insert_size_metrics('counts_table')` in SQL.

Usage

rduckhts_bam_insert_size_counts(
  con,
  path,
  reference = NULL,
  include_duplicates = FALSE,
  threads = 1,
  decompression_threads = 0,
  scan_mode = c("auto", "indexed", "sequential"),
  index_path = NULL,
  reference_index_path = NULL
)

rduckhts_bam_insert_size_counts_sql(
  con,
  path,
  reference = NULL,
  include_duplicates = FALSE,
  threads = 1,
  decompression_threads = 0,
  scan_mode = c("auto", "sequential"),
  index_path = NULL
)

Arguments

con

DuckDB connection with DuckHTS loaded.

path

BAM or CRAM path.

reference

Reference FASTA for CRAM, or NULL.

include_duplicates

Include duplicate-flagged records.

threads

Workers, from 1 to 8. The SQL wrapper temporarily sets and restores the connection's DuckDB threads setting; the native wrapper uses indexed histogram workers.

decompression_threads

htslib decompression workers per file handle.

scan_mode

SQL: auto or sequential. Native also accepts indexed; its sequential mode uses one histogram worker.

index_path

Optional BAM/CRAM index path.

reference_index_path

Optional reference FASTA index path (native only).

Value

Data frame with pair_orientation, insert_size and read_pairs. Rows are unordered; absent bins are omitted.
